scope: Controlled automated internal assessment only; human usefulness and independent trust need UNKNOWN; product/witness decision DEFER unless separately justified and authorized.
form: fresh wheel-compute with all eight accepted distributions; no package changes
arm_order: ordinary_log first when (one-based repetition + stable case index P01=1 through P08=8) is even; evidence_ledger first otherwise. Stable index never changes with the presented case order.
stopping_rule: Exactly ten repetitions per case/arm/OS. Retain every failure. No adaptive stopping, retries, dropping outliers or extra warmups. On safety/fixture/pin mismatch stop the run, mark all remaining slots NOT_RUN and invalidate the aggregate. Resume only with reviewed new run identity; do not overwrite or choose a successful rerun.

logical_storage.units: closed regular-file st_size bytes, plus separately reported transient peak and file counts; no containment claim

elapsed_overhead.zero_or_missing_baseline: show absolute paired differences; missing timing invalidates threshold, never zero-fill

automated_operation_improvement.metric: count of traced semantic operations; CLI/process wrappers cannot collapse internal work
automated_operation_improvement.interpretation: optional automation-convenience signal only; neither this nor elapsed time establishes human benefit
automated_operation_improvement.aggregation: For each OS/case/process-state, use (median baseline total operations - median evidence total operations) / median baseline total operations over all five scheduled valid repeats. At least6/8cases in EACH OS/process-state must reach0.20; all five slots must be valid or the case cannot pass. Zero baseline has undefined reduction and cannot pass; paired reductions reported descriptively only.

thresholds.product_go: NOT admissible from this automated assessment alone. Without authorized human evidence and explicit owner decision, publish DEFER even if all technical thresholds pass.
thresholds.witness_go: NOT admissible from same-owner terminals; independent-party trust need, selection and operational authority remain separate.

raw_bounds.on_limit: mark invalid/overflow; preserve prefix and failure, no complete-log claim or continuation mutation

raw_types: Closed schema; exact int nonbool >=0 for counters/ns/bytes and monotonic endpoints; return_code is exact signed int nonbool, null only if no observed process exit with explicit status. Strings/arrays bounded. Unsupported/unavailable endpoints are null with explicit status; unknown fields rejected. Each duration=end-start in same process/clock domain, never subtract parent from child clocks. Exact enum/string/trace bounds frozen and reviewed before execution.

common_files.bundle.zip: identical accepted bundle, including retained input/config/result/receipt or deliberately missing/corrupt content
common_files.task.json: closed keys schema, trial_id, narrative only; narrative is original supplied claim, never expected verdict
common_files.declared-reports.json: closed keys strict,advisory,explanation; original retained payload bytes, labeled producer declarations; cannot count as independently recomputed finding
common_files.terminal.json: only this arm original independently retained expected terminal; ordinary count/length/digest or ledger chain/version/count/head, same trust authority for both

solver_visibility.case_identifiers: may be echoed as opaque correlation IDs; MUST NOT select diagnosis, fixture reconstruction, expected output, branch or API behavior
solver_visibility.finding_sources: Report declared versus independently recomputed separately. Recompute narrative/result comparisons from retained bundle and task claim; recompute strict knowledge diagnostics from retained rows/config through accepted API. A matching declared report or logged decision alone is not a correct diagnosis.
solver_visibility.missing_input: P05 declared strict report remains admitted but recomputed_strict_admission is UNKNOWN with reason retained_input_missing; do not substitute oracle rows. P07 declared/recomputed post-load fields are null because load refuses.
